origin.description: Stack predictions from several models into one column.
origin.details: Models are row-bound in the order they were named. The model column is first.
origin.value: A taller frame, one block per model.
origin.example:
df <- data.frame(x = 1:5, y = c(1, 4, 3, 2, 5))
g <- gather_predictions(df, m1 = lm(y ~ x, data = df), m2 = lm(y ~ x, data = df))
cat(nrow(g), as.character(g$model[[1]]), "\n")
